examples.en: English is spoken in many countries.
examples.zh: 许多国家都说英语。

questions.q: The classroom _____ cleaned every day.

questions.sentence: The classroom is cleaned every day.
questions.zh: 教室每天都被打扫。

questions.q: English _____ spoken in many countries.
questions.hint: English 是单数，用 is
questions.sentence: English is spoken in many countries.
questions.zh: 许多国家说英语。

questions.q: The windows _____ cleaned by the students yesterday.
questions.hint: windows 是复数，且是昨天，用 were

questions.zh: 窗户昨天被学生们打扫了。

scenes.title: 教室里的被动语态
scenes.lead: 当动作是别人做的时候，我们用 be + 过去分词。
scenes.sentence: The classroom is cleaned every afternoon.

scenes.title: 熊猫和火锅
scenes.lead: 被动语态也可以表达‘被喜欢’、‘被享受’。
scenes.sentence: The panda is loved by people all over the world.
scenes.zh: 熊猫被全世界的人们喜爱。

scenes.title: 昨天的窗户
scenes.lead: 过去的事情用 was/were + 过去分词。
scenes.sentence: The window was broken by the wind yesterday.
